response.sql: WITH film_actor_counts AS (SELECT f.film_id, COUNT(fa.actor_id) AS actor_count FROM film f LEFT JOIN film_actor fa ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.film_id), first_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS value FROM film_actor_counts), films_above_first AS (SELECT fac.film_id, fac.actor_count FROM film_actor_counts fac CROSS JOIN first_avg fa WHERE fac.actor_count > fa.value), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS value FROM films_above_first), films_above_second AS (SELECT faf.film_id, faf.actor_count FROM films_above_first faf CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE faf.actor_count > sa.value) SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM first_avg) IS NULL OR (SELECT value FROM second_avg) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE SUM(fas.actor_count) END AS sum_actor_counts, CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM first_avg) IS NULL OR (SELECT value FROM second_avg) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AVG(fas.actor_count - (SELECT value FROM first_avg)) END AS avg_excess_first, CASE WHEN (SELECT value FROM first_avg) IS NULL OR (SELECT value FROM second_avg) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE AVG(fas.actor_count - (SELECT value FROM second_avg)) END AS avg_excess_second FROM films_above_second fas
